quality_assessment: Page provides solid practice exercises and common mistakes but lacks visual enhancements and structure improvements that would benefit from MkDocs Material features

issues.description: Page is missing MkDocs Material visual features that would improve learning experience
issues.fix_suggestion: Add admonitions for tips, warnings, and notes; use tabs for multi-language examples if applicable; add code annotations for complex examples

issues.description: Practice exercises lack expected output or validation guidance - learners don't know if they got the right result
issues.fix_suggestion: Add expected output examples or success criteria for each exercise so users can verify their understanding

issues.description: Missing exercises for advanced features like multiline search, PCRE2 patterns, and JSON output
issues.fix_suggestion: Add practice exercises for advanced features: multiline patterns with -U, PCRE2 lookaheads with -P, and JSON output with --json

issues.description: Common Mistakes section would benefit from warning admonitions to make issues stand out
issues.fix_suggestion: Wrap each mistake in a warning admonition (!!! warning) to visually distinguish problems from solutions

issues.description: Missing common mistakes related to performance, file filtering, and binary files
issues.fix_suggestion: Add common mistakes: forgetting that hidden files are excluded by default, expecting to search binary files, not using file type filters for better performance
